'''Matt Carulli''' (DeckTech handle '''QuiGon57'''; forums handle '''quickdraw3457'''<ref name="farewell">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/the-advocate-council-bids-farewell-welcomes-new-member/ The Advocate Council Bids Farewell; Welcomes New Member], starwarsccg.org (16 December 2021)</ref>)<ref name="dt-24026">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24026 Hunt Down and Revive the SCUM], DeckTech (Matt "QuiGon57" Carulli, 19 June 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/24026/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/24026/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009072433/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/24026/ Wayback Machine].</ref> served on the [[Players Committee]] as [[Design Advocate]] and then as '''Special Projects &amp; Multimedia Advocate'''.<ref name="blog2016" /><ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref> He posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list on DeckTech (''Hunt Down and Revive the SCUM'').<ref name="dt-24026" />
